name: Tom Cotton
stance: AI-as-national-security hawk: export controls on advanced compute, bans on Chinese AI models over embedded backdoors, and keeping the U.S. ahead on frontier models — safeguards framed through security, not consumer regulation.

statements.text: Wrote to Commerce Secretary Lutnick urging a strategy to counter China's AI diffusion — strict export controls on advanced compute and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and a government-wide ban on contractor use of Chinese AI models.
Backdoors may be embedded into open weight Chinese models, and auditing produces limited assurances.

we should continue to deny Communist China the frontier and limit its ability to serve customers on a global scale by enacting and enforcing strict export controls on advanced compute and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
